requirement.summary: Action 3: Update BirPreprocessShell (old/new write, daily/monthly, cleanup, On-Demand)
requirement.description:
Reference: Epic attachment bir_data_process_and_report_revamp_proposal.pdf — Action 3.

Scope:

- Update BirPreprocessShell for dual-write (old rpt_dyn_* + new pos_bir_*) during migration; new tables only after migration completes.

- Payment-level preprocess: write pos_bir_check_payments alongside existing dynamic payment table.

- Station daily summary: write pos_bir_station_summaries alongside existing dynamic business-day table.

- Monthly summary: aggregate from POS source data into pos_bir_station_monthly_summaries (invoked at Local daily close).

- Expired-data purge: 3-month daily retention, 10-year monthly/daily-info retention, temp table cleanup/DROP.

- On-Demand date-range generation into pos_bir_station_summaries_temporary / pos_bir_check_payments_temporary.

- Post-migration scheduled task: cleanup only (no HQ daily generation / backfill).
requirement.release_notes:
Enhancement: [Jira-68282] Update BirPreprocessShell (old/new write, daily/monthly, cleanup, On-Demand)
Description:
-      Update BirPreprocessShell for the new standard-table BIR preprocess architecture (Epic HERO-68279 Action 3), invoked from Local daily close via DailyPreprocessShell.
-      During migration, dual-write legacy rpt_dyn_pos_bir_* tables and new pos_bir_* tables; after migration completes, write new standard tables only.
-      Payment-level preprocess writes pos_bir_check_payments; station daily summary writes pos_bir_station_summaries; monthly summary aggregates into pos_bir_station_monthly_summaries at Local daily close.
-      Retention: purge daily rows in pos_bir_station_summaries / pos_bir_check_payments older than 3 months; apply 10-year policy on long-term tables; drop temporary tables when empty.
-      Support On-Demand date-range mode to populate pos_bir_station_summaries_temporary and pos_bir_check_payments_temporary for report on-demand flow (Action 4).
-      After migration, HQ/LS scheduled preprocess performs cleanup only (no HQ daily generation or backfill of missing days/months).
Configuration / Parameter:
-      No special UI configuration is required for daily/monthly preprocess; it runs from Local daily close / scheduled tasks.
-      Optional Report Module setting “Auto-cleanup On-Demand jobs” controls soft-delete of temporary preset and one-time tasks after on-demand send:
-
Field Definition:
-      This case does not involve field definition.
Result / Sample:
-      Open POS282 BIR Sales Summary Report and set Date type to “Specified as below” with a range older than the last 3 months (example: 2026-01-01 ~ 2026-03-31):
-
-      The report engine shows “Background generation required” and lists monthly segments for on-demand generation:
-
-      Click “Add to generation queue” to open the On-Demand Job form (report, date range, email interface, recipients, format):
-
-      After submit, the job is queued. The result page shows the created Preset Parameters id and Scheduled Task ids:
-
-      Preset Parameters listing shows the created on-demand preset (e.g. “On-demand POS282 2026-01-01 2026-03-31”):
-
-      Report Management > Scheduled Tasks lists the one-time BirPreprocessShell tasks for each month segment (BIR on-demand …):
-

# CUS0366 - System Financial Report (With Carry Forward By Monthly Or Yearly)

## Report Information

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Name | System Financial Report (With Carry Forward By Monthly Or Yearly) |
| Code | CUS0366 |

## Parameters to Validate

| Parameters Name | Description | Options | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Date Type | Select the statistics range of financial data: current month, last month, current year, last year, specific month or specific year below; if the check is a carry forward check, execute 'CarryForwardPreprocessShell' first. (single-select). Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Query Configuration: Maximum Query Days, Default: Empty, No Limit | Current Month, Last Month, Current Year, Last Year, Specific Month, Specific Year | Current Month |
| Specific Month | Specify the particular month for the statistics range; enabled when Date Type = 'Specific Month'. | - | - |
| Specific Year | Specify the particular year for the statistics range; enabled when Date Type = 'Specific Year'. | - | - |
| Shops | Filter report data by shop. (multi-select). Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Show Shop Short Name = Yes/No, Default: No | All, Single, Multiple | All |
| Outlets | Filter report data by outlet under the selected shops. (multi-select) | All, Single, Multiple | All |
| Separate Outlet | Consolidate or separate report data by outlet; outlet name field shows when Separate Outlet = Yes; source expect-result wording for Yes/No behaviors conflicts. QA没有标准,请PO提供方案. (single-select) | Yes, No | No |
| Format | File format of the exported report file. (single-select) | Xlsx, Csv | Xlsx |

## Data Fields to Validate

| Fields Name | Fields Description | Field Calculation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Report Title | Show corresponding report title by selection Date Type / Shops / Outlets: show report name; if a single shop is selected show shop name, else no show; if a single outlet is selected show outlet name, else no show; if Current/Last Month or Current/Last Year is selected, display date format according to System Management >> System Configuration >> Report Module 'Date Format' settings; if Specific Month, display date format as YYYY-M; if Specific Year, display date format as YYYY | - |
| Outlet Name | Show outlet name if Separate Outlet = Yes | - |
| Net Sales Total | Show check net sales. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . | Today settled check - Yesterday outstanding + Today outstanding |
| Covers | Show total number of guests | - |
| Cover Average | Show average consumption of guests; note: if Covers = 0, this field = Net Sales. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . | Net Sales / Covers |
| Checks | Show the amount of checks; when a check carries forward from previous day to current day, this field does not count that check on current day | - |
| Check Average | Show check average; note: if Checks = 0, this field = Net Sales. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . | Net Sales / Checks |
| Outstanding Checks As At Today | Show the amount of the business day checks not settled on the day it is carried. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . | - |
| Outstanding Service Charge As At Today | Show service charge data of unsettled checks on today's business day. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . | - |
| Outstanding Checks As At Yesterday | Show the total number of outstanding checks in the previous business day | - |
| Outstanding Service Charge As At Yesterday | Show service charge data of unsettled checks on yesterday's business day. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . | - |
| Department - Revenue | Show item department name, sorted by Idep_seq from menu_item_depts; support setup of Revenue Department and Non-Revenue Department shown in report by Config by Location -> Department Revenue Code. Settings: Go to Platform > System Configuration > Report > Mapping Configuration: Department Mapping, Default: Empty, No Limit | - |
| No. of Item (Revenue Department) | Show the number of sales by the item department | - |
| Amount (Revenue Department) | Show item department sold amount. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . | - |
| Total (Revenue Department) | Show 'No. of Item' and 'Amount' totals of revenue department | Sum of No. of Item (Revenue Department) and Amount (Revenue Department) |
| Discount Name | Show discount type name; extra charge is not displayed | - |
| No. of Item (Discount) | Show discount type quantity; this field also counts data on carry forward checks | - |
| Amount (Discount) | Show discount type amount (check discount and item discount). Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . | - |
| Total (Discount) | Show 'No. of Item' and 'Amount' totals of discount | Sum of No. of Item (Discount) and Amount (Discount) |
| Svc Chg | Show service charges total (S.C1-5). Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . | - |
| Gratuity | Show gratuity amount. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . | - |
| Tax | Show Tax + Inclusive Tax (1-25). Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . | Tax (1-25) + Inclusive Tax (1-25) |
| Total Revenue | Show total check revenue. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . | - |
| Department - Non-Revenue | Show item department name, sorted by Idep_seq from menu_item_depts; support setup of Revenue Department and Non-Revenue Department shown in report by Config by Location -> Department Revenue Code. Settings: Go to Platform > System Configuration > Report > Mapping Configuration: Department Mapping, Default: Empty, No Limit | - |
| No. of Item (Non-Revenue Department) | Show the number of sales by the item department | - |
| Amount (Non-Revenue Department) | Show item department sold amount. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . | - |
| Total (Non-Revenue Department) | Show 'No. of Item' and 'Amount' totals of non-revenue department | Sum of No. of Item (Non-Revenue Department) and Amount (Non-Revenue Department) |
| Charged Tips | Show payment tips + residue. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . | - |
| Rounding | Show rounding amount. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . | - |
| PayGroup | Show pay group name | - |
| Payment | Show payment name. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Mapping Configuration: Payment Mapping, Default: Empty, No Limit | - |
| No. of Settlement (Payment) | Show payment times; this field also counts data on carry forward checks | - |
| Amount (Payment) | Show payment amount + tips. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . | Payment Amount + Tips |
| Sub Total (Payment) | Show PayGroup No. of Settlement and Amount sub totals | - |
| Total (Payment) | Show all PayGroup No. of Settlement and Amount totals | - |
